basic_details.job_title: HPSCDRC Senior Scale Stenographer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (HPSCDRC) is inviting applications by post for 1 Senior Scale Stenographer vacancy under its 2026 recruitment. Eligible candidates can submit their offline application in the prescribed proforma through their Controlling Authority to the Registrar, H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla, with the application reaching the office on or before 30 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Applicants for the Senior Scale Stenographer post must possess a Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent from a recognized University, 100 wpm English shorthand

application_fee.details: The application fee of Rs. 500/- must be paid in the shape of Demand Draft or Indian Postal Order, payable in favour of Registrar, H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla. The fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

rows.details: H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla
Bachelor's Degree with shorthand/typing speed and computer knowledge

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and desirous candidates shall submit their applications offline in the prescribed proforma available on the official website http://hpconsumercommission.nic.in. The application must be forwarded through the candidate's Controlling Authority to: The Registrar, H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla-9, Himachal Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Feeder Category: Junior Scale Stenographers/Steno typist/Judgment Writers working in the Hon'ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh, District Judiciary in the State, and Government/Semi-Government establishments, having five (05) years of regular service or regular combined with continuous ad hoc service in the feeder category. Educational and Technical Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent from a University recognized by the Government of Himachal Pradesh. English Shorthand speed: 100 words per minute (W.P.M.). English Typing Speed: 40 words per minute (W.P.M.). Adequate knowledge of word processing on computer. faq.question: Q1. Who is eligible to apply for the Senior Scale Stenographer post?
faq.answer: Junior Scale Stenographers, Steno typists, or Judgment Writers working in the Hon'ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh, District Judiciary, and Government/Semi-Government establishments with 5 years of regular or combined regular and continuous ad hoc service in the feeder category who hold a Bachelor's Degree and meet the shorthand and typing speed requirements can apply through their Controlling Authority.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications at the Commission office is 30.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the application fee and how should it be paid?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-, payable in the shape of a Demand Draft or Indian Postal Order in favour of the Registrar, H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla.

faq.question: Q4. Where should the offline application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed proforma through the candidate's Controlling Authority to the Registrar, H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Shimla-9.
